race.description: Spanline Orange & Bathurst Country Boosted Hcp (Bm50)
race.comment: Tough contest to end the day. XCEPTIONAL SPIRIT (11) strengthened up over the break and looks hard to catch again with the claim. Went out hard and nailed late with a respectable third over 900m at Queanbeyan. Has the gate speed to take up a forward position. CAN DO IT (2) saves his best for the home track and this trip. Returned from a lengthy break with a game third from off the speed over 1000m here. Has a good second up record and maps to get the gun run. BROGANS CREEK (12) deep into the campaign and returned to form with a game victory over 1100m in a BM50 at Mudgee on a rain affected track. Senior rider hops aboard and sure to be thereabouts. WELLSPRING (4) is stepping out at this track for the first time. Last appeared when he scored over 1000m at Grenfell on September 26. Can feature.
